#!/bin/sh
# Copies every file under SOURCE into DEST, keeping relative paths, and reports each copy.
# Usage: sh backup.sh [--dry-run] SOURCE DEST
set -eu
dry_run=false
if [ "${1:-}" = "--dry-run" ]; then
    dry_run=true
    shift
fi
src=$1
dest=$2
find "$src" -type f | sort | while IFS= read -r file; do
    rel=${file#"$src"/}
    if [ "$dry_run" = true ]; then
        printf 'would copy %s\n' "$rel"
        continue
    fi
    mkdir -p "$dest/$(dirname "$rel")"
    cp "$file" "$dest/$rel"
    printf 'copied %s\n' "$rel"
done

events.text: backup.sh now takes --dry-run and only reports what it would copy.
